parent_objective: design targeted reset-only validation for M1811 materialized stable sources
blocked_by: M1811 materialized sources require reset validation before repaired reset feasibility or measured execution
supersedes: direct reset execution without validation design

public_gates: M1813 must design targeted reset-only validation without running reset or rollout
M1813 must define inputs expected counts conversion or adapter requirements pass/fail criteria and claim boundary
M1813 must choose the next implementation execution-design or repair route explicitly
M1813 must keep reset rollout measured rollout training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes profile tuning ranking paper-level and level3 claims blocked

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs targeted reset-only validation after M1812 audits materialized sources as complete
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: reset-validation design only; no reset, rollout, measured rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if design would run reset
stop if materialized artifacts cannot be converted to reset-ready specs
stop if expected counts are ambiguous
stop if measured execution or ranking is admitted before reset support
fallback_plan: route to reset-validation adapter implementation if conversion is required
route to execution design if existing adapter can consume the artifacts
route to materialization repair if artifacts are insufficient

admission_evidence: M1812 audits M1811 artifacts as complete and ranking-blocked
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1813 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for adapter implementation execution design or repair
next_stage_criteria: reset-validation inputs and counts are explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: not applicable; reset-validation design covers task-quality source support.
history_necessity_tests: Design must preserve all profile controls for later L1/L2/L3 comparisons.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If reset validation cannot be designed cleanly, route to adapter repair or materialization repair rather than weakening self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: targeted reset-validation design and route decision
no reset, rollout, measured rollout, training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A targeted reset-only validation protocol can be designed for the three M1811 materialized stable sources without running reset or admitting measured execution.
success_criteria: design lists input artifacts and expected target counts
design states whether adapter/conversion is required
design keeps measured execution and ranking blocked
no reset rollout measured rollout training replay PPO ranking or paper-level claim is made
failure_criteria: design routes directly to measured execution or ranking
design changes actor inputs reward dynamics or termination behavior
decision_rule: M1813 passes if it designs targeted reset-only validation without reset, rollout, ranking, or paper-level claims.
